build_arena: build an empty arena with a ground plane and camera by instantiating the Arena class
build_arena_with_name: build a named empty arena by passing a name string to the Arena constructor
get_ground: get the ground plane mjcf geom element from an Arena instance using the ground property
get_mjcf_model: get the mjcf RootElement for the arena using the mjcf_model property
review_arena_class: review the Arena class to understand how it loads empty_assets/arena.xml via mjcf include_copy
